title: Senior Consultant (m/w/d) Daten & KI-Strategie
description:
Über uns: Wer/Was ist Artefact?

Artefact ist eine weltweit führende Beratung für Daten- und KI-Dienstleistungen mit Hauptsitz in Paris. Mit mehr als 2.000 Consultants, Data Scientists und Engineers in 26 Ländern arbeiten wir mit den globalen Marktführern zusammen. An unseren deutschen Standorten befinden wir uns auf einem rasanten Wachstumskurs. Wir beraten führende nationale und internationale Kunden branchenübergreifend dabei, das volle Potenzial ihrer Daten auszuschöpfen, skalierbare Datenarchitekturen aufzubauen und innovative KI-Lösungen zu implementieren.

Als Senior Consultant (m/w/d) Data & AI Strategy stehst du im Mittelpunkt dieser Mission. Du lieferst nicht nur statische Präsentationen, sondern schlägst die Brücke zwischen technologischen Möglichkeiten und geschäftlichen Anforderungen. Dabei begleitest du unsere Kunden von fokussierten Kurzzeit-Projekten im gehobenen Mittelstand bis hin zu mehrphasigen KI-Transformationen in Großkonzernen. In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die Verantwortung für crossfunktionale Workstreams, treibst datenbasierte Entscheidungen voran und gestaltest die digitale Zukunft unserer Kunden aktiv mit.

 

Das erwartet dich bei uns:

  • Kundenberatung & Strategie: Du arbeitest eng mit (internationalen) Kunden zusammen, verstehst deren geschäftliche Anforderungen und übersetzt diese in datengestützte Empfehlungen, die strategische Entscheidungen und die Business Transformation unterstützen.
  • Daten & Analyse: Du sammelst, strukturierst und bereitest Daten für Analysen auf. Mit Tools wie Excel, SQL und Python identifizierst du Trends, Muster und konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen und kommunizierst diese klar an technische sowie nicht-technische Stakeholder.
  • Projektumsetzung: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für Projekt-Workstreams und stellst eine qualitativ hochwertige, termingerechte Lieferung im Einklang mit den übergeordneten Projektzielen sicher. Dabei arbeitest du kollaborativ in interdisziplinären Teams aus den Bereichen Consulting, Data und Tech.
  • Daten- & KI-Lösungen: Du unterstützt die Entwicklung von Datenstrategien, KI-Use-Cases sowie Business-Intelligence-Lösungen und wirkst bei Governance-Frameworks und Implementierungs-Roadmaps mit.
  • Wissenstransfer & Kollaboration: Du trägst zu einer starken Teamkultur bei, indem du dein Wissen teilst, dich über digitale Trends und KI-Entwicklungen auf dem Laufenden hältst und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung des Teams unterstützt.

 

Das bringst du mit:

Im Kern definieren wir uns über eine Kultur der Eigenverantwortung, der intellektuellen Neugier und der Zusammenarbeit. Wir suchen motivierte, fähige und umsichtige Talente, die hungrig auf neue Herausforderungen sind und die Chance nutzen wollen, zu lernen und zu wachsen.

  • Berufserfahrung: Du verfügst über mindestens 2-3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Management-/Datenberatung oder in einer entsprechenden Inhouse-Funktion. Zudem bringst du nachweisbare Erfolge in den Bereichen Daten-/KI-Strategie, Cloud-Transformation oder angewandte KI-/Machine-Learning-Projekte mit.
  • Daten- & KI-Verständnis: Du besitzt eine hohe Affinität für Datenmanagement und moderne KI-Technologien. Konzepte wie Generative KI, LLMs oder Predictive Analytics sind dir vertraut und du brennst darauf, die Lücke zwischen Business-Anforderungen und KI-Einsatz zu schließen. Idealerweise hast du bereits Erfahrung in der Konzeption von KI-Use-Cases oder im Data-Platform-Tracking.
  • Business-Orientierung & analytisches Denken: Du verbindest ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten mit einer geschäftsorientierten Denkweise. Es macht dir Spaß, geschäftliche Herausforderungen zu identifizieren und sie in praktische, KI- und datengestützte Lösungen zu übersetzen.
  • Technische Fähigkeiten: Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Excel und PowerPoint. Praktische Erfahrung mit Statistik-Tools, BI-Software oder Programmiersprachen wie SQL, R oder Python zur Datenexploration und -aufbereitung ist ein klares Plus.
  • Kommunikation & Teamgeist: Du kommunizierst komplexe technische Themen sowohl auf Deutsch als auch auf Englisch klar und verständlich. Du arbeitest gerne in interdisziplinären Teams und schätzt die Zusammenarbeit über verschiedene Ebenen und Funktionen hinweg (z. B. als Übersetzer der Anforderungen zwischen Business-Stakeholdern und Data Scientists).
  • Persönlichkeit: Du agierst proaktiv, strukturiert sowie lösungsorientiert und zeichnest dich durch eine ausgeprägte Kunden- und Stakeholder-Orientierung aus. Du blühst in dynamischen Umfeldern auf und hast Freude daran, komplexe Probleme zu lösen.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind eine Grundvoraussetzung. Du wirst an Kunden-Workshops teilnehmen, Präsentationen vor hochrangigen Entscheidungsträgern halten und Dokumente in beiden Sprachen verfassen. Weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.
  • Arbeitserlaubnis: Eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland.

 

Warum ARTEFACT?

  • Einflussreiche Kundenprojekte: Arbeite an anspruchsvollen Projekten mit führenden nationalen und internationalen Kunden in den Bereichen Daten, Digitalisierung und zukunftsweisende Datenstrategie.
  • Karriere- und Entwicklungschancen: Wir glauben an Leistung, nicht an Dienstalter. Dein Aufstieg wird durch deinen Impact bestimmt, nicht durch deine Betriebszugehörigkeit - mit klaren Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten und vielfältigen Karriereperspektiven.
  • Attraktive Vergütung: Ein starkes Vergütungspaket inklusive eines leistungsabhängigen Bonus, der halbjährlich ausgezahlt wird.
  • Lernen & Weiterentwicklung: Werde Teil eines Teams aus passionierten Data Consultants, die sich gegenseitig aktiv unterstützen. Du lernst durch vielfältige Projekte, enge Zusammenarbeit und den Austausch mit führenden Experten der Branche - internationale Einsätze eingeschlossen.
  • Flexibilität & Freizeit: Unbegrenztes Homeoffice und flexible Arbeitszeiten, 28 Tage Jahresurlaub sowie zusätzliche freie Tage über die Feiertage (Weihnachten und Silvester frei) und an deinem Geburtstag.

 

Diese Position ist für die Standorte Berlin oder München ausgeschrieben.

Keine Sorge, wenn du nicht alle Kriterien erfüllst! Bei Artefact schätzen wir Motivation, pragmatische Problemlösungskompetenz und Potenzial über alles. Wenn du hungrig auf neue Herausforderungen bist und die KI-Revolution leidenschaftlich mitgestalten willst, freuen wir uns von dir zu hören.

Vielfalt & Inklusion bei Artefact: Wir sind überzeugt, dass einzigartige Perspektiven Innovationen vorantreiben. Bei Artefact setzen wir uns für ein inklusives Umfeld ein, in dem jeder sich entfalten kann. Wir begrüßen und berücksichtigen alle Bewerbungen rein auf Basis von Leistung, Fähigkeiten und Potenzial – unabhängig von geschlechtlicher Identität, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Ethnizität, Religion, Alter, Hintergrund oder Behinderung. Komm so, wie du bist!

title: Senior Consultant (m/f/d) Data & AI Strategy
description:
Who/What is Artefact?

Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organizations through data and AI. We combine the rigor of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital, and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact. With 2,000+ consultants, data scientists, and engineers across 26 countries, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange, and Sanofi. At our German offices, we are on a rapid growth trajectory, advising leading national and international clients cross-industry on how to unlock the full potential of their data, build scalable data architectures, and implement cutting-edge AI solutions.

As a Senior Consultant (m/f/d) Data & AI Strategy, you will sit at the center of this mission. You won't just deliver static slides; you will bridge the gap between technical possibilities and business imperatives, guiding clients from a focused short-term engagement with Mittelstand manufacturers to multi-phase AI transformations with enterprises. In this role, you will take ownership of cross-functional workstreams, drive data-driven decision-making, and actively shape the digital future of our clients.

 

What you will do:

  • Client advisory & strategy: Work closely with (international) clients to understand their business needs and translate them into data-driven recommendations that support strategic decision-making and business transformation.
  • Data & analysis: Collect, synthesise and iterate data to create actionable insights. You work with a modern, AI-native toolstack - from LLM-powered environments (e.g. Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) and agentic workflow tools (e.g. n8n, Lovable) to coding assistants and automation platforms - and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Familiarity with SQL or Python remains a plus, but the ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate analysis and delivery is what we value most.
  • Project delivery: Take ownership of project workstreams and ensure high-quality, timely delivery in alignment with overall project goals. Work collaboratively within interdisciplinary teams across consulting, data, and tech functions.
  • Data & AI solutions: Support the development of data strategies, AI use cases, and business intelligence solutions, contributing to governance frameworks and implementation roadmaps where relevant.
  • Knowledge sharing & collaboration: Contribute to a strong team culture by sharing knowledge, staying up to date with digital and AI trends, and supporting continuous team development.
  • Business development & thought leadership: Actively contribute to Artefact’s growth in Germany - supporting client proposals, shaping new service offerings, and creating intellectual capital such as frameworks, point-of-views, and benchmarks that strengthen our market position.

 

Candidate Profile

At our heart, we define ourselves by a culture of ownership, intellectual curiosity, and cooperation. We are looking for driven, capable talents who bring strong motivation and curiosity for new challenges. 

  • Experience: You have at least 2–3 years of experience in management consulting, technology consulting, or in-house corporate strategy roles, with a proven track record of participating in data/AI strategy, cloud transformation, or applied AI/Machine Learning projects.
  • Education: A completed university degree (Bachelor’s or Master's) in Business Administration, Economics, Computer Science, Business Informatics, Physics, Mathematics, or a comparable quantitative field.
  • Data & AI Fluency: You possess a strong affinity for data management and modern AI technologies. You are familiar with concepts like Generative AI, LLMs, or predictive analytics and are eager to bridge the gap between business needs and AI deployment. Ideally, you have hands-on experience in AI use case conceptualization or data platform tracking.
  • Business & analytical mindset: You combine strong analytical skills with a business-oriented perspective. You enjoy identifying business problems and translating them into practical AI and data-driven solutions.
  • Technical skills: You are confident working with PowerPoint and Google Slides to produce polished client-ready output. More importantly, you know how to leverage AI tools - from LLM environments to agentic workflows - to run analysis, generate insights, and accelerate delivery. Experience with SQL, BI tools, or programming languages is not a requirement, but comfort with structured data and a hands-on attitude toward new tools is expected.
  • Communication & collaboration: You communicate complex technical topics clearly in both German and English. You enjoy working in interdisciplinary teams and collaborating across different levels and functions (e.g., translating requirements between business stakeholders and data scientists).
  • Personal attributes: You are proactive, structured, and solution-oriented, with a strong client focus and stakeholder understanding. You thrive in dynamic environments and enjoy solving complex problems.
  • Languages: Business-fluent German and English are required - you will participate in client workshops, present to senior stakeholders, and write deliverables in both languages. Additional languages are a plus.
  • Work Eligibility: A valid work permit for Germany.

 

Why ARTEFACT?

  • Impactful client work: Work on challenging projects with leading national and international clients across data, digitalisation, and advanced data strategy.
  • Career growth opportunities: We believe in performance over tenure. Your growth is driven by your impact, not your length of service, with clear opportunities to progress and diverse career prospects.
  • Competitive rewards: A strong compensation package including a performance-based bonus, which is paid out half-yearly.
  • Learning & development: Join a team of passionate Data Consultants who actively support each other. You'll learn through diverse projects, collaboration, and exposure to leading experts in the field - including international work.
  • Flexibility & time off: Hybrid working model, 28 days of annual leave, plus your birthday as well as Christmas & New Year's Eve off.

 

This position is based in Berlin or Munich.

Don't worry if you don't meet all the criteria! At Artefact, we value motivation, pragmatic problem-solving, and potential above all else.If you are excited about shaping the future of AI and ready to make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Diversity & Inclusion at Artefact > We believe that unique perspectives fuel innovation. At Artefact, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome and consider all applications purely based on merit, skills, and potential - regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, religion, age, background, or disability. Come as you are!

Ready to take the next step? Please submit your CV showcasing your experience and passion for this role as a Senior Consultant (m/f/d) Data & AI Strategy. We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Site Reliability Engineer

As a part of Sony Computer Entertainment, the Gaming, Developer & Future Technology Group (GDFT) is leading the cloud gaming revolution, putting console-quality video games on any device, from TVs to consoles to mobile devices and beyond.

Our Site Reliability Engineering team plays a significant role in delivering on the promise of a great cloud gaming experience to our customers. We do this by influencing design and operational decisions towards the overall stability of the gaming service. Our SREs focus on three main things: overall ownership of production, production code quality, and deployments. The successful candidate will be self-directed and able to participate in the way we make decisions at different levels.

We expect our SREs to have opinions on the state of our service and provide critical feedback during different phases of the operational lifecycle. We are engaged throughout the software development lifecycle, ensuring the operational readiness and stability.

What you'll be doing:

  • Lead team technical discussions, especially around ongoing improvements in Reliability and Scalability
  • Be involved in creating High Level Designs (HLDs) for new products and platforms
  • Mentor junior SRE staff and enable them for success
  • Lead incident response and post-mortem activities within your assigned service team
  • Work with other Engineers in a cross-functional team to prioritise reliability improvements to address technical debt and toil
  • Contribute to code to improve reliability
  • Implement automation to reduce ongoing toil

What we're looking for:

  • Minimum of 5+ years working experience in Software Development and/or Linux Systems Administration role.
  • Strong interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills.
  • Available to be scheduled in on-call rotation.

Skills & Knowledge:

  • Proficient as a Linux Production Systems Engineer, with experience managing large scale Web Services infrastructure.
  • Development experience in one or more of the following programming languages:
  • Python (preferred)
  • Bash, Go, Java, C++, or Rust
  • In addition, experience with at least 3 of the following topics:
  • Distributed data storage at scale (Hadoop, Ceph)
  • NoSQL at scale (MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra)
  • Data Aggregation technologies. (ElasticSearch, Kafka)
  • Scaling and running traditional RDBMS (PostgreSQL, MySQL) with High Availability
  • Monitoring & Alerting (Prometheus, Grafana), and Incident Management toolsets
  • Kubernetes and/or AWS (deployment and management)
  • Software Distribution (Package management and distribution at scale)
  • Configuration Management (ansible, saltstack, puppet, chef)
  • S/W Performance analysis and load testing (QA or SDET experience: a plus)

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice (where applicable) for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.

Senior-level experience in IT systems engineering, network engineering, systems administration, or related information technology roles. Strong knowledge of network protocols, routing, switching, firewall administration, and enterprise network architecture. Experience administering Windows and Linux server environments and associated enterprise services. Experience implementing, monitoring, and troubleshooting complex network and systems infrastructure. Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, network security controls, and information assurance requirements. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to coordinate with technical teams, leadership, and government stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications: Industry certifications such as Cisco CCNA/CCNP, CompTIA Network+, Security+, CISSP, Microsoft Certified, VMware Certified Professional (VCP), or equivalent credentials. Experience supporting USACE, DoD, FEMA, DHS, or other federal information technology and emergency management programs. Experience supporting emergency operations centers, disaster recovery operations, continuity of operations (COOP), or field-deployed technology systems. Familiarity with cloud computing environments including Microsoft Azure, AWS, or hybrid cloud architectures. Experience with virtualization technologies, network automation, and scripting languages such as PowerShell or Python. Knowledge of NIST cybersecurity frameworks, Risk Management Framework (RMF), and federal information security requirements. Responsibilities: Manage advanced IT infrastructure and systems supporting emergency response, disaster recovery, and recovery operations. Design, configure, maintain, and optimize network infrastructure including routers, switches, firewalls, wireless networks, and telecommunications systems. Administer enterprise server environments, storage systems, virtualization platforms, and supporting applications. Monitor network and system performance, identify operational issues, and implement corrective actions to maintain service availability and reliability. Implement and maintain cybersecurity controls, access management procedures, intrusion detection systems, VPNs, and security monitoring capabilities. Support deployment and operation of temporary communications systems, field technology assets, and emergency operations infrastructure. Develop and maintain network diagrams, system documentation, configuration records, and operational procedures. Support disaster recovery planning, backup management, continuity of operations activities, and system restoration efforts. Coordinate with government personnel, contractors, telecommunications providers, and cybersecurity teams to support operational requirements. Participate in emergency response support activities and provide technical assistance during disaster recovery operations as required. Strong knowledge of routing, switching, firewall management, wireless networking, virtualization, server administration, and enterprise architecture is essential for maintaining secure and reliable technology environments. Experience troubleshooting complex network and system issues, implementing cybersecurity controls, and supporting continuity of operations is critical for ensuring operational readiness during disaster response missions. The candidate should demonstrate proficiency in Windows and Linux environments, cloud technologies, virtualization platforms, and network monitoring tools. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities are required to diagnose technical issues, implement effective solutions, and maintain high system availability under demanding operational conditions. Excellent written and verbal communication skills are necessary for preparing technical documentation, coordinating with multidisciplinary teams, and supporting engagement with government stakeholders. Familiarity with NIST standards, federal cybersecurity requirements, and emergency management operations is highly desirable for successful performance under the USACE READI contract.
